cohort: A total of 309 women diagnosed with gestational glucose intolerance or gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) were included, with a median age of 31 years and a median pre-pregnancy BMI of 22.3 kg/m2.
finding: Different metabolic phenotypes of GDM were associated with heterogeneous pregnancy outcomes, with women having higher pre-pregnancy BMI or insulin resistance experiencing a greater risk of adverse outcomes such as LGA newborns and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with insulin resistance had a higher risk of cesarean section (aOR, 2.12; 95% CI, 1.29 to 3.50; P=0.003) compared to women in the insulin-sensitive group.
